steps.text: Cook bacon in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned. Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon drippings. Crumble bacon; set aside.

Meanwhile, place eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water; bring to a boil. Cover, remove from heat, and let eggs stand in hot water for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove eggs from hot water and cool under cold running water; peel and cut into wedges.
Heat reserved 2 tablespoons drippings in the same skillet; stir in vinegar, water, sugar, and salt. Keep warm.
Wash and remove stems from spinach; dry thoroughly. Tear into pieces in a salad bowl; add warm dressing and toss until coated.
Top salad with mushrooms and bacon; garnish with egg.

raw_recipe.headline: Spinach and Mushroom Salad
raw_recipe.description: This spinach and mushroom salad recipe combines fresh spinach, crumbled bacon, and sliced mushrooms, topped with a warm and tangy bacon vinaigrette.

review.reviewBody: This was delicious!

based upon others reviews, I increased the amount of dressing. A lot! I used olive oil instead of bacon fat, and a half and half mix of balsamic and cider vinegar. I made about a cup of dressing, for about 12 ounces of spinach. My guests did everything but like the bowl! :) (I also used the precooked bacin from Costco)

I love spinach salads and this one was a treat. 

I did double up on the dressing as others had noted it was dry. I also used shiitake mushrooms and a good, thick sliced, smokey bacon. 

This was a pre meal salad and made a great presentation. There was none left! Will definitely repeat.

Great recipe! Easy to make and tasted like a gourmet salad. Hubby and I loved it! I cheated and used the packaged real bacon pieces, but I did warm them in some olive oil w/the mushrooms, some minced garlic and 4 chopped green onions. I also used Splenda instead of the white sugar in the dressing, and only used the egg whites on the salads, and it still turned out great. Thanks for a new favorite salad!
I would reduce the amount of salt in this recipe by half to one third. Otherwise it was great!

Not a fan. I really didn't like the dressing in this salad. I'm glad I tasted it prior to tossing the spinach in it as it was just too greasy for me. I ended up making an impromptu dressing (mayo, milk, apple cider vinegar, salt & pepper) and it was much lighter and my guests gobbled it up!

Yum! Used turkey bacon and some bacon bits. I let them(bacon) sit in about two tablespoons of warmed olive oil to infuse bacon flavor.I also added about half of a finely chopped small sweet onion to bacon-olive oil mix. Plan on growing spinach in my garden this year just so I can make this more often. Yummy!!!

I made this recipe exactly except for using only 7oz of spinach as I was only serving two. My husband said it needed more egg. I also doubled the dressing as suggested by others. I used olive oil instead of bacon grease for the doubling because I didn't have enough. We really liked it and I will definitely make it again.

Not bad - the salad itself is a great start but the dressing had its flaws. In a nutshell it was too watery, too sweet and lacking any real depth or complexity of flavor. This could be improved by eliminating the water, decreasing the sugar and considering using honey instead, and adding a smidge of Dijon mustard.

I gave this four stars only because I made several changes for my families taste. I cut the sugar, vinegar, and water in half. We just prefer it that way. I left out the eggs and added minced garlic and red onion slices. Will definitely make again.
Loved the recipe! I added red onions and it was perfect!
Even without the bacon, it was delicious.
Very good salad.
Used the dressing part of it . Loved it. Used spinach, mushrooms, bacon and hard boiled eggs. Great.
Everyone raved when it took this to a dinner party! Made it as per recipe instructed and added cherry tomatoes. Thanks for a five star recipe!
I made this tonight. I followed the recipe almost to the tee... I added raw onion for myself and left it out for my wife. I must say - this is one fantastic salad. Well done.

I've always loved this salad. Found I needed 8 slices of bacon to produce the bacon grease needed. Also used 1 Tbs of apple cider vinegar & 1 Tbs of white balsamic. I want to use all of my spinach in my raised bed garden for this salad!

Quite liked this recipe. Had bacon bits so just used 2 tbsp. vegetable oil instead of bacon fat. Quick, easy and tasty!
My husband had never had a warm dressing and he really enjoyed it as well. Will definitely make this again!
Great recipe, The dressing is perfectly lovely- I made it with olive oil instead of bacon grease which is much more heart healthy. Tasted great! thank you for the recipe!
Can't got wrong with spinach bacon and mushrooms
